caveats.caveat: DR08 gate 5 has no benchmark data for ES/GB/IT (FINDING EU-S2-04). The gate compares monthly GHI against a local reference file, deliberately, because live fetches are forbidden and would make the verdict unreproducible. Six such files are needed (three folds x two candidate years) and none exists. The France benchmark existed only as a markdown table until it was materialised on 2026-08-26.
caveats.measured_extent: 7 of 7 required fold-year benchmarks now exist (fr 2023 transcribed; es 2009/2010, uk 2014/2015, it 2013/2014 acquired 2026-08-26)
caveats.must_not_conclude: That any fold outside France therefore promotes. The benchmark is one of gate 5 two inputs; the EPW is the other, and no fold outside France has a ruled weather year (C-17).
caveats.resolution: Resolved 2026-08-26. scripts/acquire_pvgis_monthly_ghi_benchmarks.py acquired the six missing fold-year files directly from PVGIS MRcalc v5_3 at the registry coordinates, verbatim and unrounded, each carrying its own endpoint and retrieval date. The script refuses to re-query the France file, whose numbers the RULED_PINNED_EXCEPTION was granted against. The caveat is retained, not removed: it records that a data dependency of gate 5 was discovered only when the gate was built, and that no gate-5 verdict predating 2026-08-26 for es, uk or it can exist.

caveats.amendment: Figures restated 2026-08-26 under D-EU-17 (a). The S2 heating figures quoted above - 618782.3181 kWh and 31.2144 kWh/m2 - are WITHDRAWN: they were computed with every zone volume substituted at 10.0 m3 (C-20). The repaired run (openubem/outputs/eu_evidence/EU-04/s2_campaign_v2/) gives 1364091.4373 kWh and 68.8114 kWh/m2 over the SAME 19823.6173 m2, a 2.20x increase. The denominator did not move, which is itself the evidence that the modelled floor area was sound and only the third dimension was not. Nothing else in this caveat changes: the evidence fold is still fr and still shares no fold, no building and no weather file with the 510 campaign cells.
caveats.caveat: The evidence bundle and this specification share no fold (FINDING EU-S2-05). CAMPAIGN_FOLDS is (es, uk, it) and the 510 cells are es 120 / uk 180 / it 210. Everything actually simulated in this arc - the 31 buildings, 618782.3181 kWh, 19823.6173 m2, 31.2144 kWh/m2, the S2 gate report and the one weather file that ever passed six gates - is fold fr, FR-LYO-HAUTCOEURPENTES 2023, which is not a campaign fold.
caveats.measured_extent: 0 of 510 campaign cells were simulated; 0 of 510 carry a pinned weather file
caveats.must_not_conclude: That the campaign specification was validated on 31 real buildings, or that the pinned France weather lends its RULED_PINNED_EXCEPTION status to any campaign cell. It does not. The S2 bundle shows the pipeline runs end to end; the specification fixes the boundary Step 8 consumes. They answer different questions.

caveats.caveat: Every simulated zone ran with a 10.0 m3 volume (FINDING EU-S2-07). EnergyPlus calculated a NEGATIVE zone volume in 103 of 103 zones across 31 of 31 buildings and substituted a fixed 10.0 m3. Ventilation is ZoneVentilation:DesignFlowRate with calculation method AirChanges/Hour at 0.567 ACH, and EnergyPlus derives the flow as ACH x zone volume / 3600, so the ventilation heat loss scales directly with the substituted volume. ROOT CAUSE, named in the codebase's own words at openubem/idf/builder.py:217-234 (OPEN-56): geomeppy's by_storey/WHOLE extrusion path uses raw, unoriented footprint coordinates, so floor normals point the wrong way and the divergence-theorem volume comes out negative. The main pipeline has been immune since OPEN-56 because BuildingIDF calls _write_zone_volumes after extrusion; the two EU runner scripts never did. This is an EU-path defect, not a fleet-wide one.
caveats.measured_extent: 103 of 103 zones in 31 of 31 buildings, measured from eplusout.eio. Volume simulated 10.0 m3 in every zone without exception; total air volume simulated 1030.0 m3. EnergyPlus's own reported Ceiling Height is 3.00 m in every zone and total reported Floor Area is 19823.64 m2, so the true air volume is 59470.92 m3 and the UNDERSTATEMENT IS 57.74x AGGREGATE, 8.23x to 122.52x per zone (median 46.78x). SUPERSEDED FIGURE: an earlier reading of 19.2x took the magnitude of the negative calculated volume as the true volume; that magnitude is floor area x 1 m, an artifact of the divergence sum under a flipped floor normal, and not evidence that the zones are 1 m tall. The zones are 3 m tall and the error is three times larger than first stated.
caveats.must_not_conclude: That 31.2144 kWh/m2 is a heating demand for these buildings. It was computed with the ventilation heat loss understated 57.74x. The sign of the error is known - the true figure is materially higher - so the number must not be quoted at all, not with a caveat and not with an uncertainty band.
caveats.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-26 under D-EU-17 (a), in two repairs. Repair 1 (s2_campaign_v2/): write_zone_volumes after extrude_geometry in both EU runners - 0 of 103 zones left at 10.0 m3, total 59470.94 m3 against 59470.92 m3 predicted before the run. Repair 2 (s2_campaign_v3/): the footprint winding itself oriented counter-clockwise, which removed the GetVertices warning repair 1 had left behind. s2_campaign_v3/ is the authoritative bundle: G8.15 PASS 31/31 with zero untriaged kinds, 0 return codes non-zero, 0 severe, 0 fatal. FINAL RESTATEMENT: 31.2144 kWh/m2 WITHDRAWN -> 60.7087 kWh/m2 (1203465.4667 kWh) on the same 19823.6173 m2. The caveat is retained, not removed: it records that an EU-specific runner bypassed a fix the shared builder already carried, that no S2 heating figure predating 2026-08-26 can be quoted, and that the intermediate 68.8114 kWh/m2 from repair 1 is itself superseded.
caveats.ruling: D-EU-17 ruled 2026-08-26, option (a): repair, re-run, restate. 31.2144 kWh/m2 is WITHDRAWN and preserved as superseded. The repair writes Zone.Volume explicitly as floor area x storey height rather than leaving it to EnergyPlus's calculation - the same remedy OPEN-56 applied to the main pipeline - and G8.15 is re-scored on the repaired outputs. This caveat is retained, not removed: it records that an EU-specific runner bypassed a fix the shared builder already carried, and that no S2 heating figure predating the repair can be quoted.
caveats.successor_finding: C-21 (FINDING EU-S2-08) - the winding carried an 11.8% energy error of its own, independent of the volume.

caveats.caveat: Vertex order alone is worth 11.8% of heating demand (FINDING EU-S2-08). Repairing the zone volume explicitly (C-20 repair 1) left the underlying reversed floor winding in place. Orienting the footprints counter-clockwise afterwards changed total heating from 1364091.4373 kWh to 1203465.4667 kWh - a 11.8% drop - while EnergyPlus's own reported total zone floor area (19823.64 m2), total zone volume (59470.94 m3), exterior gross wall area (16582.10 m2) and heat-transfer surface count (1681) were byte-identical between the two runs. The vertex SETS are identical; only their ORDER differs. Reversing a ring reverses the outward normal, which is what tells EnergyPlus which face is outdoors; areas and volumes are orientation-blind, convection coefficients and longwave sky exchange are not.
caveats.measured_extent: 31 of 31 buildings, 103 of 103 zones. -11.8% on the aggregate; the effect sits entirely ON TOP of the 57.74x volume error, since the volumes were already repaired when it was measured. Blast radius measured, not assumed: 41 non-EU EnergyPlus runs under openubem/outputs/ were checked for 'Floor is upside down' and 'Indicated Zone Volume' - 0 occurrences of either - so the adopted fleet baseline is not implicated. That is a measurement over 41 runs, not a proof over every configuration.
caveats.must_not_conclude: That fixing a 10.0 m3 substitution by writing the volume explicitly makes a model correct. It repairs the consequence and removes the warning that would have revealed the cause. Nor that an area-based or volume-based geometry check can detect this class of defect: every such quantity was identical across the two runs. Only the warning text and the energy result differed.

caveats.amendment: Amended 2026-08-26, FINDING EU-S2-10. A fold promoted with a gate-5 documented exception is now written RULED_PINNED_EXCEPTION, not RULED_PINNED, so the exception is visible in the artefact that CROSSES THE BOUNDARY rather than only in the evidence behind it. es was corrected in place and the DRAFT's 120 pinned cells now carry RULED_PINNED_EXCEPTION; under D-EU-18, uk and it are expected to do the same. Rule established: when a fact is recorded in several places, audit the copy the consumer actually reads.
caveats.caveat: Gate-5 winter exceptions for uk and it are PRE-AUTHORISED, not individually ruled (D-EU-18, ruled 2026-08-26 option (a)). Every fold-year gated so far - fr 2023, es 2009, es 2010 - failed DR08 gate 5 on exactly one winter month (FINDING EU-S2-06), because the gate is a RELATIVE test at a fixed 10 percent and ERA5's known winter cloud bias against PVGIS SARAH is largest in relative terms precisely where absolute irradiance is smallest. Rather than ask the owner the same question four more times, seven quantitative bounds were fixed BEFORE the London and Bologna archives finished downloading, and a uk or it fold-year meeting all seven is promoted with PASS_WITH_DOCUMENTED_EXCEPTION and no further ruling.
caveats.measured_extent: The seven bounds: gates 1,2,3,4,6 all PASS; at most 2 offending months in the year; every offending month's benchmark total below 80 kWh/m2; every offending month's relative delta at most 20 percent; every offending month's absolute gap at most 15 kWh/m2; annual delta at most 5 percent; the exact month list, each delta, each gap and the annual delta written into weather_registry.json. Worst value across the three already-approved fold-years: 1 month, 53.69 kWh/m2 benchmark, 14.13 percent, 8.93 kWh/m2, 3.23 percent annual - so every bound carries headroom over evidence the owner had already accepted on its own merits. Breaching ANY single bound grants nothing and escalates that fold-year as its own decision request.
caveats.must_not_conclude: That a uk or it EPW passed all six DR08 gates cleanly. It passed with named excepted months under a pre-registered rule. Nor that the 10 percent tolerance was widened - it was not; only the decision procedure for granting a documented exception was pre-committed. Nor that fr or es are covered: the mechanism refuses every fold other than uk and it BY NAME, and the fr and es exceptions remain the individually ruled ones of D-EU-07 and D-EU-15.

cell_id_note: cell_id is an index key, not a complete provenance key. Weather identity lives in each cell's epw_path, weather_id and weather_sha256 fields. A consumer that hashes cell_id alone and expects it to pin the weather input is using it wrongly.
